# API reference

Every operation of the haau3 platform API (`1.0.0-preview.19`) is a method on `Haau3` and on
`AsyncHaau3`, named by its operationId in snake_case. Each links to its page on docs.haau3.com, which
shows its parameters and an example exchange. Path values come first, then `body` for an operation
that takes one, and the query parameters are keyword arguments named by the API's own names in
snake_case (`name:contains` is `name_contains`, `_count` is `count`); each method's docstring gives
both. Every method also takes the per-call options `timeout`, `max_retries`, `correlation_id` and
`extra_headers`, and `client.with_response.<method>(...)` gives the request id and timing too.

An operation that declares a header takes it as one more keyword, named from the header in snake_case and
checked before sending: `process_message` takes `payer_authorization`, sent as `Payer-Authorization`.

`batch()` sends several of these as one request, each with its own answer or error, from the entries
`haau3.calls` makes. It takes every operation on the FHIR base except `fhir_batch`, `process_message` and `reconcile_medications`: 29 of the
39. See the README's "Several requests in one".

| [`list_specialties(**query)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/scheduling/list-specialties) | `GET /v1/scheduling/specialties` | List specialties |

## FHIR base

What the FHIR R4 base at `/v1/fhir/r4` answers for every service on it: the `CapabilityStatement` that lists them all, and batch Bundles that carry several requests to any of them in one round trip.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`fhir_batch(body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/fhir-base/run-several-operations-in-one-request-batch) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4` | Run several operations in one request (batch) |
| [`fhir_metadata(**query)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/fhir-base/capability-statement) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/metadata` | Capability statement |

## Questionnaires

FHIR Questionnaire, served as its source publishes it. This service holds copies of a curated set and reaches any other questionnaire its source publishes by canonical URL, as well as forms published at their own address under places this service is set up to reach. Read one by id, and build the QuestionnaireResponse in your own application.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`search_questionnaire(**query)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/questionnaires/list-or-find-a-questionnaire) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/Questionnaire` | List or find a questionnaire |
| [`read_questionnaire(id)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/questionnaires/read-a-questionnaire) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/Questionnaire/{id}` | Read a questionnaire |

## Medical Benefits

FHIR InsurancePlan: what a Medicare Advantage or ACA Marketplace plan covers and what a member pays, read from the files CMS publishes. Every plan names the CMS release it was read from. Read a plan by its id, or search by identifier, name, state or county, and check whether the CMS National Provider Directory lists providers in a plan's network.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`search_insurance_plan(**query)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/find-a-plan) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan` | Find a plan |
| [`list_insurance_plan_counties(*, state)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/list-a-states-counties) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/$counties` | List a state's counties |
| [`read_insurance_plan(id)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/read-a-plan) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/{id}` | Read a plan |
| [`check_insurance_plan_network(id, *, npi)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medical-benefits/check-providers-against-a-plans-network) | `GET /v1/fhir/r4/InsurancePlan/{id}/$in-network` | Check providers against a plan's network |

## Pharmacy Benefits

The CARIN Consumer Real-Time Pharmacy Benefit Check as FHIR messaging: what a medication would cost a member under their coverage, or its price at pharmacies near a ZIP code, in real time, from the sources this service connects to. A member's request receives patient data, so send it only under an executed agreement.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`process_message(body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/pharmacy-benefits/check-what-a-medication-costs-pharmacy-benefit-check) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4/$process-message` | Check what a medication costs (pharmacy benefit check) |

## MedList

One reconciled medication list from one patient's FHIR medication records, as US Core MedicationRequests with a Provenance for each. This operation receives patient data, so send it only under an executed agreement.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`reconcile_medications(body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/medlist/reconcile-one-patients-medication-records) | `POST /v1/fhir/r4/$reconcile-medications` | Reconcile one patient's medication records |

## Sandbox

The FHIR base without production behind it, to build and test against: the same paths at `/v1/sandbox/fhir/r4`, answered with synthetic data that always gives the same answer. Its first service is the CARIN Consumer Real-Time Pharmacy Benefit Check, answered by Example Health Plan, a test insurer. It takes a test key (`haau3_sk_test_…`), made on the API keys page, and each request counts like any other. Send test members only, never a real person.

| Method | Request | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`sandbox_process_message(body)`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/sandbox/check-a-test-members-medication-cost-with-a-test-insurer) | `POST /v1/sandbox/fhir/r4/$process-message` | Check a test member's medication cost with a test insurer |
| [`sandbox_metadata()`](https://docs.haau3.com/api-reference/sandbox/the-sandboxs-capability-statement) | `GET /v1/sandbox/fhir/r4/metadata` | The Sandbox's capability statement |
